_comment: Code-scanning alerts dismissed by .github/workflows/code-scanning.yml (contrib/secops/code-scanning-triage.py). One entry per tool + rule + path glob: reason is one of 'false positive', 'won't fix', 'used in tests'; comment is the argument a reviewer can check (280 characters reach GitHub). A real finding is fixed in code, never listed here.

dismissals.comment: X402_API_KEY is an operator-generated bearer secret (>=16 chars, README: openssl rand -hex 32), not a user password. SHA-256 only equalises lengths for timingSafeEqual; no digest is stored or persisted and the key itself is in process memory, so a slow KDF protects nothing.

CommandSaplingBuilder runs the builder command the operator configures (--sapling-builder / X402_SAPLING_BUILDER / AGENT_SAPLING_BUILDER) with sh -c by design; the flagged source is the devnet test's own repo path (examples/.../devnet/procs.ts). No network input reaches it.

The node RPC client: the URL and credentials come from the operator's devnet.json or the node's own .cookie file (basic auth to that node, by design), and request params from the facilitator's own JsonFile store. Sent only to the operator-configured ycashd RPC URL.

Read-only smoke helper run by the operator: it reads the node URL/credentials from the operator's devnet.json or ycashd .cookie file (X402_DEVNET_JSON / X402_RPC_COOKIE_FILE) and sends them as basic auth to that same node. That is the intended RPC login.

All hits are assert/panic messages in sync.rs's #[cfg(test)] mod tests (lines > 474), printing a SyncReport (heights and counters) or an error; the taint source is self.account(), an AccountUuid (an identifier, not a key). No key or seed is logged.
Regtest integration test: the assert message prints birthday, a block height on the test's own regtest chain, and the receipt height. Not secret; test code only.

Byte-identical to ycash-dd and ycash6 src/crypto/pq/falcon/ (cmp, 2026-10-24); unmodified PQClean solve_NTRU_binary_depth1 reuses the uint32 scratch as fpr by design: 8-byte-aligned union, 14336 B, depth 1 uses 11264 B. Dismissed in ycash6 with the same proof.

Byte-identical to ycash-dd and ycash6 src/crypto/pq/falcon/ (cmp, 2026-10-24); unmodified PQClean sampler: z0 = gaussian0_sampler() counts over its 18-row table, so 0 <= z0 <= 18 and z0*z0 <= 324; no int overflow before the int64_t conversion.
